responsibility: This header declares the C interface for gm2 scope and block management. It exposes the routines that other frontend components use to push and finish global or function binding levels, maintain declaration and statement lists, preserve global constants and types from collection, create labels, and access the current GCC statement list while lowering Modula-2 constructs to trees.
same_name_distinction: This header is the native C/C++ declaration companion to m2block.cc, listing gm2 block/scope helpers, current statement-list accessors, and global-context queries for other frontend sources. Unlike m2block.def it is not the Modula-2-facing API, and unlike m2block.cc it has no binding-level logic.
